subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: A winter tour across Northeast China, starting in Harbin with Russian-style sights, Ice-Snow World and the Siberian Tiger Park, then Changchun and Shenyang with its Imperial Palace. Stay in 5-star hotels; meals include a free upgrade to Ice Palace hot pot and BBQ. Flights go via Guangzhou.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Dec 28–Jan 3 2026 to Dec 28–Jan 3 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Chateau Volga: A Russian-style estate in Harbin with wooden houses, gardens and period buildings.
placeDesc.St. Nicholas Church: A Russian Orthodox-style church site visited as part of the Russian-heritage stops in Harbin.
placeDesc.Vodka Fort: A Russian-themed venue where the tour includes a small vodka tasting and a snack.
placeDesc.Pushkin Exhibition Hall: An exhibition hall in Harbin dedicated to the Russian poet Alexander Pushkin.
placeDesc.Songhua River: The river running through Harbin, with a cable car crossing offered as an optional tour.
placeDesc.Stalin Park: A riverside park on the Songhua River in Harbin, popular for walks and city views.
placeDesc.Central Street: Harbin's famous pedestrian street lined with European-style buildings.
placeDesc.Sophia Church Square: The square around Harbin's Byzantine-style Saint Sophia Cathedral, a city landmark.
placeDesc.Harbin Ice-Snow World: A winter theme park in Harbin filled with giant ice and snow sculptures, lit up in the evening.
placeDesc.Siberian Tiger Park: A wildlife park near Harbin that breeds Siberian tigers, one of the largest cats in the world.
placeDesc.Harbin Grand Theater: A modern, wave-shaped landmark theatre on the Songhua River in Harbin, seen from outside.
placeDesc.Nanhu Park: A lakeside city park in Changchun, visited as a scenic stop.
placeDesc.Shenyang Imperial Palace: The early Qing dynasty imperial palace in Shenyang, now a museum and UNESCO World Heritage site.
placeDesc.Street of the Qing Dynasty: A restored old street beside the Shenyang Imperial Palace with Qing-style shops and architecture.
